title: Multi-Asset Composite Dual Momentum (20+ Asset Universe)
source: Geczy & Samonov 2015 (SSRN:2607730); Antonacci Composite Dual Momentum extension; H256 failure analysis
rationale: H256 (Antonacci GEM) failed OOS 2015-2025 because the binary equity/bonds gate fails when bonds and stocks crash together (2022: TLT -26%, SPY -18%). The fix is a broader multi-asset universe with 4 separate modules, each with its own relative+absolute momentum gate. Multiple escape routes mean the strategy can find positive absolute momentum in at least one module even during equity+bond simultaneous crashes. Geczy & Samonov document 2-century multi-asset momentum with consistent Sharpe across stocks, bonds, currencies, and commodities.

design.signal: 6-month absolute + relative momentum within each module
design.allocation: Equal weight to each module (25% each); within module, best asset by relative momentum; if absolute negative go defensive

confirm_gates.vs_h256: must beat best H256 variant by Sharpe > 0.15

hypothesis_log_entry.note: Extension of H256 (NOT CONFIRMED). Key innovation: 4-module structure with equity + credit + real assets + international allows defensive exit in one module while others remain invested. Reduces single-point-of-failure in 2022 style joint bond+equity crash.
